title: Official Veneto SP638 road extraction and centerline preparation
hypothesis: The official Veneto road graph can identify SP638 deterministically and provide a presentation centerline aligned to the same terrain AOI.
technical: Official Veneto WFS returned road features for the AOI.
SP 638 DEL PASSO GIAU (BL) was selected from source attributes rather than guessed.
Route id 000000027157 and node topology were used to assemble the centerline.
Presentation Z was sampled from the canonical terrain source and converted to Unreal-local coordinates.
visual: GIS overlay/centerline evidence passed as a source-alignment proof.
keep: Official Veneto WFS as canonical presentation-road source.
Node-topology assembly and deterministic GIS -> UE conversion.
Strict separation between presentation road and FRouteGeometryProfile physics truth.
reject: Manual tracing of SP638 or nearest-line guessing when official topology is available.
learnings: Real road alignment can be sourced reproducibly without coupling simulation physics to GIS geometry.
next: Persist the official centerline as an Unreal spline in the isolated Passo Giau map.
